scope: Environment prefab SpriteRenderer ShadowCaster2D geometry; 41 unique sprite PNGs. Excludes walls, doors and creatures.
acceptedFurnitureLight: C dark top and directional matte edge; starts by default in the three-object study. Library-wide lighting material integration remains separate.
correction: Generate the render outline directly from current source PNG alpha, threshold 51/255, detail .25, zero extrusion. Write through ISpriteOutlineDataProvider with capability guards; preserve sprite identity and placement. Closed RDP polyline simplification: up to 2 source pixels; retain contours with <=16 points, winding changes, >1% area change or self intersections. Final imported triangles are separately compared to source alpha.

measurement.metric: area intersection over union of actual triangle mesh and source alpha > 51, 4-pixel grid of pixel centers
measurement.coordinates: vertex * PPU + pivot; source image origin bottom-left
measurement.limit: Sampled area accuracy, not exact raster equality or physical correctness of projected shadows.

verification.buildWarnings: Final incremental build: zero. Earlier full build: six existing obsolete API warnings from EnvironmentLoadProbe.cs.
verification.rejectedEvidence: Runtime OverrideGeometry reconstruction was rejected by Unity. Those errors were archived; all mislabeled old/new reconstruction captures were excluded. No successful before/after screenshot claim.
verification.excludedCandidates: An intermediate RDP candidate lost part of the triangulation on simple shapes; it was rejected. Small contours and intersection/area guards were added, then all 41 actual meshes were checked again.

limitations: URP planar shadows remain long; no height-aware occlusion was implemented.
No alpha sampling at runtime and no additional shadow casters or light sources.
Vertex counts increased; earlier light benchmark predates this change.
C is accepted visually, with integration still scoped to the three study objects.

caveats: Development DX11 1080p on the same laptop; not a release FPS or pure CPU budget.
The dense-sixty ceiling-on condition drifted strongly across repetitions (C GPU segment medians 10.65 to 19.47 ms) and is excluded from comparisons. Cause was not isolated.

The Editor was observed on EnvironmentNarrativeStressReview after the run; concurrent user/editor activity was not controlled, so comparisons to historical runs are indicative rather than isolated causal measurements.
Stable flashlight-only dense condition: C GPU segment medians 5.543 to 5.629 ms, median 5.544. B/C remain similar within this condition.
